description: Implementation of LwM2MService interface for managing LwM2M server security configurations, including fetching public keys and certificates, with dependency injection of server configurations.

classes.name: LwM2MServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing LwM2MService for handling server security info retrieval and configuration.

methods.name: getServerSecurityInfo
methods.description: Returns security configuration info for a given server, indicating if it's a bootstrap server.

methods.name: getServerSecurityConfig
methods.description: Constructs security configuration object from server config, encoding public key and certificate as Base64 strings.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key bytes from SSL credentials, handling exceptions.

methods.name: getCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain's first certificate bytes from SSL credentials, handling exceptions.
